faqs.question: Do you sell lab-grown diamonds?
faqs.answer: No. We sell natural stones only, certified by GIA or IGI. If you want a lab-grown stone we will tell you honestly where to get one.

faqs.question: Can I see the certificate before I buy?
faqs.answer: Yes. The certificate for your specific stone is shown at the table and handed over with the piece.

faqs.question: Is everything hallmarked?
faqs.answer: Every gold piece carries a BIS hallmark and a HUID number. You can verify the HUID yourself on the BIS Care app.

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment?
faqs.answer: No. Walk-ins are welcome. An appointment means we keep an hour aside and the person who will make your piece is at the table.

faqs.question: Is there a private room?
faqs.answer: Yes. One private cabin, available on request when you book.

faqs.question: How long does a commission take?
faqs.answer: Two to four weeks for most pieces. Bridal sets can take longer depending on the setting work.

faqs.question: Can you rework my mother's jewellery?
faqs.answer: Yes. The original gold and stones stay yours and are returned to you. Nothing is melted without your consent in writing.

faqs.question: What does lifetime service cover?
faqs.answer: Cleaning, polishing, re-plating and tightening, free, forever, on anything we have made. See the aftercare page for what is chargeable.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: If you are having something reworked, bring the piece and the original bill if you have it. Otherwise, photographs of anything you like are more useful than a description.

faqs.question: How long does a first visit take?
faqs.answer: About an hour. We keep the slot free either side so you are not moved along.

faqs.question: Can I bring my family?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most bridal appointments are three or four people. Tell us when you book and we will seat you properly.

faqs.question: What if I am running late?
faqs.answer: Call or WhatsApp. The slot is yours for the day; we will fit you in whenever you arrive.

faqs.question: Will I be pressured to buy?
faqs.answer: No. We contact you once to confirm and once on the day, and not again after your visit.
